# Read RSEM data for allele specific expression
```{r}
# Make counts by rsem 
library(tximport)
# Base directory for RSEM outputs
rsem_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/rsem_quantification/nonase_quantification/"
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_metadata_with_ibdpainting_all_samples.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
# Construct sample paths 
sample_paths <- file.path(rsem_base_dir)
# Collect gene results 
files <- file.path(sample_paths, paste0(sampledata$Sample_id, ".genes.results"))
# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]
# Get the sample IDs from sampledata that correspond to existing files
file_indices <- which(file.exists(files))
fileSampleIDs <- sampledata$Sample_id[file_indices]
# Create a named vector for tximport with proper sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs
# Verify the names are correct
head(names(existing_files))
# Perform tximport for RSEM quantification
txi.rsem <- tximport(existing_files, type = "rsem")

# Check column names now
head(colnames(txi.rsem$counts))
dim(txi.rsem$counts)

# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampledata[sampledata$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id

# Subset txi.rsem
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.rsem object
txi.rsem$counts <- txi.rsem$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$abundance <- txi.rsem$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$length <- txi.rsem$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]

# Now extract counts
counts <- txi.rsem$counts
rownames(counts) <-rownames(txi.rsem$counts)
dim(counts)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
colnames(counts) <- (paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Replicate,
                                     filteredSampleData$Request_id,filteredSampleData$Sample_id, sep="_"))
# Define variant 
variant <- factor(filteredSampleData$Variant)
genotype <- factor(filteredSampleData$Genotype)
d0 <- DGEList(counts = counts)
d0 <- d0[rowSums(d0$counts) > 0, ]
# Keep genes/TEs with >= 10 counts total across all samples (not restricted to ddm1_ct)
keep <- rowSums(d0$counts) >= 5
d0_filtered <- d0[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
# Normalize
d0_filtered <- calcNormFactors(d0_filtered)

# Print summary
cat("Total genes before filtering:", nrow(d0), "\n")
cat("Genes retained after filtering:", nrow(d0_filtered), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(nrow(d0_filtered)/nrow(d0)*100, 1), "%\n")

# Before filtering
log_cpm_before <- cpm(d0, log=TRUE)
# After filtering
log_cpm_after_manual <- cpm(d0_filtered, log=FALSE,normalized.lib.sizes=FALSE)
log_cpm_after_manual <- log2(log_cpm_after_manual+1)
log_cpm_after <- log_cpm_after_manual
# Plot density distributions
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(density(log_cpm_before), main="Before filtering", xlab="log2 counts")
plot(density((log_cpm_after)), main="After filtering", xlab="log2 counts")
```
## PCA of genes and TEs colored based on the allele
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Separate the two allele matrices
tair <- log_cpm_after[grepl("_tair10$", rownames(log_cpm_after)), , drop = FALSE]
acc  <- log_cpm_after[grepl("_100752$", rownames(log_cpm_after)), , drop = FALSE]

# Strip suffixes to get matching feature IDs
rownames(tair) <- sub("_tair10$", "", rownames(tair))
rownames(acc)  <- sub("_100752$", "", rownames(acc))

# Split feature IDs into Genes vs TEs
gene_ids <- grep("^AT[1-5]G",  intersect(rownames(tair), rownames(acc)), value = TRUE)
te_ids   <- grep("^AT[1-5]TE", intersect(rownames(tair), rownames(acc)), value = TRUE)


meta_ase <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(tair),
  Genotype = sub("^(F1_[^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", colnames(tair))
)

run_pca <- function(ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title) {
    x <- t(cbind(tair[ids, ], acc[ids, ]))
    pca_info <- data.frame(
        Allele   = rep(c("TAIR10", "100752"), each = ncol(tair)),
        Genotype = rep(meta_ase$Genotype, times = 2)
    )

    pca <- prcomp(x, scale. = FALSE)
    var_exp <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

    ggplot(
        data.frame(pca$x, pca_info),
        aes(PC1, PC2, color = Allele, shape = Genotype)
    ) +
        geom_point(size = 4) +
        labs(
            title = title,
            x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
            y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")
        ) +
        theme_classic()
}

p_genes <- run_pca(gene_ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title = "PCA - Genes")
p_tes   <- run_pca(te_ids,   tair, acc, meta_ase, title = "PCA - TEs")

p_genes
p_tes
```
## Upload probabilities defined by RSEM and attach them to the analysis
```{r}
library(data.table)
aln <- fread(
  "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/rsem_quantification/all_alignments_combined.tsv",
  header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
  col.names = c("sample_id", "read_id", "transcript_id", "STAR_NH", "RSEM_ZW"),
  na.strings = "NA"
)[!is.na(RSEM_ZW)]

## Add STAR multimapping/ and probability 
aln[, `:=`(
  sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
  STAR_NH = as.integer(STAR_NH),
  RSEM_ZW = as.numeric(RSEM_ZW)
)]

genes <- aln[grepl("^AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}\\.[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", transcript_id)] # Select only genes
# Select genome id 
genes[, `:=`(
  gene_id = sub("^(AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}).*$", "\\1", transcript_id),
  genome  = sub("^.*_([A-Za-z0-9]+)$", "\\1", transcript_id)
)]
```

```{r}
## ---------------------------------------------------------
## GOAL: Build a read-level table with:
##   - RSEM weight assigned to tair10
##   - RSEM weight assigned to 100752
##   - STAR NH value for that read
## ---------------------------------------------------------

## Step 1: For each read + gene + genome, add up the RSEM weight
## (this collapses isoforms, since multiple transcripts of the
## same gene/genome are summed together)
weights_by_read_gene_genome <- genes[
  , .(weight = sum(RSEM_ZW)),
  by = .(sample_id, read_id, gene_id, genome)
]

## Step 2: Turn the "genome" column into two separate columns
## (one per genome), so each read+gene has its weights side by side
weights_wide <- dcast(
  weights_by_read_gene_genome,
  sample_id + read_id + gene_id ~ genome,
  value.var = "weight",
  fill = 0
)
## Step 3: Get the STAR NH value for each read
## (take the max in case a read has multiple NH entries recorded)
nh_per_read <- genes[
  , .(NH = max(STAR_NH)),
  by = .(sample_id, read_id)
]
## Check for malformed records
nh_per_read <- unique(
  genes[, .(sample_id, read_id, NH = STAR_NH)]
)
anyDuplicated(nh_per_read, by = c("sample_id", "read_id")) # If 0 -each read has its unique value 
## Step 4: Attach the NH value onto our weights table
## This matches rows by sample_id + read_id, and copies NH over
weights_wide[
  nh_per_read,
  NH := i.NH,
  on = c("sample_id", "read_id")
]


read_gene <- weights_wide

gene_table <- read_gene[
  tair10 + `100752` > 0,
  .(
    supporting_reads = .N,
    NH_median = as.numeric(median(NH, na.rm = TRUE)),
    multimapped_frac = mean(NH > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prob_tair10 = sum(tair10) / (sum(tair10) + sum(`100752`))
  ),
  by = .(sample_id, gene_id)
]

gene_table[, prob_100752 := 1 - prob_tair10]

head(gene_table)
```
## Attach to RSEM and Greg's counts 
```{r}
## Check genes that have certain determination to one of the genomes. Attach RSEM counts and Greg's counts 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

pattern <- "^(F1_(?:Col|ddm1))_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$"

tair_long <- tair %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c(
      "genotype",
      "accession_id",
      "replicate",
      "plate",
      "run_id"
    ),
    names_pattern = pattern,
    values_to = "expression_tair10_nonase"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    accession_id = as.integer(accession_id),
    replicate     = as.integer(replicate),
    plate = as.integer(plate),
    run_id        = as.integer(run_id)
  )



acc_long <- acc %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c(
      "genotype",
      "accession_id",
      "replicate",
      "plate",
      "run_id"
    ),
    names_pattern = pattern,
    values_to = "expression_acc"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    accession_id = as.integer(accession_id),
    replicate     = as.integer(replicate),
    plate = as.integer(plate),
    run_id        = as.integer(run_id)
  )

expression_ase <- inner_join(acc_long,tair_long)

```

```{r}
## Read Greg's data 
genes_ase <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/ASE_diploid_counts_filtered.csv.gz", sep=",", header=T)
expression_ase_genes_validated <- inner_join(expression_ase,genes_ase, by=c("ID", "genotype", "accession_id", "run_id"))
expression_ase_genes_validated$e.col.norm = expression_ase_genes_validated$e.col / expression_ase_genes_validated$expected_e.col
expression_ase_genes_validated$e.col.norm<- log2(expression_ase_genes_validated$e.col.norm+1)
expression_ase_genes_validated$e.acc.norm = expression_ase_genes_validated$e.acc / expression_ase_genes_validated$expected_e.acc
expression_ase_genes_validated$e.acc.norm<- log2(expression_ase_genes_validated$e.acc.norm+1)
## Select necessary columns 
ase_rsem_gregs  <- expression_ase_genes_validated %>% dplyr::select(ID,run_id,genotype,expression_tair10,expression_acc,e.col.norm,e.acc.norm,n_variants_retained)
## Attach to the probabilities
gene_table$sample_id <- as.numeric(gene_table$sample_id)
ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities <- inner_join(gene_table,ase_rsem_gregs, by=c("gene_id"="ID", "sample_id"="run_id"))
```
## Visualize reads clearly mapped to the accession/TAIR10
```{r}
setDT(ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities)
ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[, confidence_group := fcase(
  prob_tair10 >= 0.99, "confident_tair10",
  prob_100752 >= 0.99, "confident_acc",
  prob_tair10 == 0.50 & prob_100752 == 0.50, "ambiguous_50_50",
  default = "other"
)]
ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities <-ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities$supporting_reads>10,]

tair10_genes <-ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities$prob_tair10>0.99 & ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities$genotype=="F1_ddm1",]
acc_genes <-ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities$prob_100752>0.99 &ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities$genotype=="F1_ddm1",]

tair10_genes <- ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[prob_tair10 > 0.99, .(sample_id, gene_id)]
acc_genes <- ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[prob_100752 > 0.99, .(sample_id, gene_id)]

common_within_sample <- merge(
  tair10_genes,
  acc_genes,
  by = c("sample_id", "gene_id")
)
nrow(common_within_sample)

## Allelic bias 
ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[
  gene_id %in% common_genes,
  .(sample_id, gene_id, prob_tair10, prob_100752, genotype)
][order(gene_id, sample_id)]
```
## Make a boxplot
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Keep confidence groups of interest and genes with sufficient read support
plot_data <- melt(
  ase_rsem_gregs_with_probabilities[
    confidence_group != "other"
  ],
  id.vars = c("sample_id", "gene_id", "confidence_group", "genotype"),
  measure.vars = c(
    "expression_tair10",
    "expression_acc"
  ),
  variable.name = "expression_measure",
  value.name = "expression"
)


# Remove missing and non-finite expression values
plot_data <- plot_data[
  !is.na(expression) & is.finite(expression)
]
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = confidence_group,
    y = expression,
    fill = expression_measure
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    outlier.alpha = 0.2

  labs(
    x = "Assignment confidence group",
    y = "Expression",
    fill = "Expression measure"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )+facet_wrap(~genotype)
```

##OLD





```{r}
# Expression matrices for each parental allele
tair <- log_cpm_after[grepl("_tair10$", rownames(log_cpm_after)), , drop = FALSE]
acc  <- log_cpm_after[grepl("_100752$", rownames(log_cpm_after)), , drop = FALSE]

# Remove the terminal allele suffix
rownames(tair) <- sub("_tair10$", "", rownames(tair))
rownames(acc)  <- sub("_100752$", "", rownames(acc))

# Retain features represented by both alleles
paired_features <- intersect(rownames(tair), rownames(acc))

tair <- tair[paired_features, , drop = FALSE]
acc  <- acc[paired_features, , drop = FALSE]

# Ensure samples are in the same order
stopifnot(identical(colnames(tair), colnames(acc)))

# Positive = TAIR10-biased; negative = 100752-biased
ase_delta <- tair - acc
dim(ase_delta)
ase_delta[1:5, ]
```

```{r}
## Separate genes and TEs
feature_type <- ifelse(
    grepl("^AT[1-5]TE", rownames(ase_delta)),
    "TE",
    ifelse(grepl("^AT[1-5]G", rownames(ase_delta)), "Gene", "Other")
)

table(feature_type)
```

```{r}
data.frame(colname = colnames(ase_delta), sample_id = sample_ids)
```

```{r}
## Match with ASE data
# Extract Sample_id from each ase_delta column
sample_ids <- sub(".*_", "", colnames(ase_delta))
# Match expression columns to metadata
idx <- match(sample_ids, as.character(metadata$Sample_id))

# Stop if any sample was not found
stopifnot(!anyNA(idx))

# Metadata ordered exactly like ase_delta columns
meta_ase <- metadata[idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Verify the matching
data.frame(
    expression_sample = colnames(ase_delta),
    extracted_id = sample_ids,
    metadata_id = meta_ase$Sample_id,
    genotype = meta_ase$Genotype
)
# Check 
table(meta_ase$Genotype)
```

```{r}
## Create summary table 
mean_ase_col <- rowMeans(
    ase_delta[, meta_ase$Genotype == "F1_Col", drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
)

mean_ase_ddm1 <- rowMeans(
    ase_delta[, meta_ase$Genotype == "F1_ddm1", drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
)

ase_summary <- data.frame(
    feature_id = rownames(ase_delta),
    ASE_Col = mean_ase_col,
    ASE_ddm1 = mean_ase_ddm1,
    ASE_change = mean_ase_ddm1 - mean_ase_col,
    row.names = NULL
)

head(ase_summary)
ase_summary[
    order(abs(ase_summary$ASE_change), decreasing = TRUE),
][1:20, ]
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

run_heatmap <- function(ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title) {

  mat <- cbind(tair[ids, ], acc[ids, ])
  colnames(mat) <- make.unique(colnames(mat))

  annotation_col <- data.frame(
    Allele   = rep(c("TAIR10", "100752"), each = ncol(tair)),
    Genotype = rep(meta_ase$Genotype, times = 2),
    row.names = colnames(mat)
  )

  pheatmap(
    mat,
    scale = "row",
    show_rownames = FALSE,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
    clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
    main = title
  )
}

run_heatmap(gene_ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title = "Heatmap - Genes")
run_heatmap(te_ids,   tair, acc, meta_ase, title = "Heatmap - TEs")
```

```{r}
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", aes(label = after_stat(r.label))) +
  facet_wrap(~genotype~replicate) +
  coord_equal() +
  xlim(0, max(c(
    expression_ase_genes_validated$expression_tair10,
    log2(expression_ase_genes_validated$e.col.norm + 1)
  ), na.rm = TRUE)) +
  ylim(0, max(c(
    expression_ase_genes_validated$expression_tair10,
    log2(expression_ase_genes_validated$e.col.norm + 1)
  ), na.rm = TRUE))

  
expression_ase_genes_validated %>%
  filter(n_variants_retained > 5) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(e.col.norm, e.acc.norm),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(expression = log2(expression + 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = expression, fill = factor(genotype))) +
  geom_histogram(
    alpha = 0.6,
    position = "identity",
    bins = 50
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~replicate) +
  labs(
    x = "log2(normalized expression + 1)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Genotype"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Compare to the expression levels detected by rsem 
```{r}
library(tximport)
# Base directory for RSEM outputs
rsem_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/rsem_quantification/nonase_quantification/nonase_quantification"
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_metadata_with_ibdpainting_all_samples.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
# Construct sample paths 
sample_paths <- file.path(rsem_base_dir)
# Collect gene results 
files <- file.path(sample_paths, paste0(sampledata$Sample_id, ".genes.results"))
# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]
# Get the sample IDs from sampledata that correspond to existing files
file_indices <- which(file.exists(files))
fileSampleIDs <- sampledata$Sample_id[file_indices]
# Create a named vector for tximport with proper sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs
# Verify the names are correct
head(names(existing_files))
# Perform tximport for RSEM quantification
txi.rsem <- tximport(existing_files, type = "rsem")

# Check column names now
head(colnames(txi.rsem$counts))
dim(txi.rsem$counts)

# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampledata[sampledata$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id

# Subset txi.rsem
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.rsem object
txi.rsem$counts <- txi.rsem$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$abundance <- txi.rsem$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$length <- txi.rsem$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]

# Now extract counts
counts <- txi.rsem$counts
rownames(counts) <-rownames(txi.rsem$counts)
dim(counts)
```

## Calculate parental probabilities
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

mapping_gene <- mapping %>%
  mutate(
    gene_pair = str_remove(
      transcript_id,
      "\\.\\d+_(tair10|100752)$"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
parental_probabilities <- mapping_gene %>%
  filter(
    NH > 1,
    subgenome %in% c("tair10", "100752"),
    !is.na(ZW)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    read_id,
    gene_pair,
    subgenome
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    probability = sum(ZW),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = subgenome,
    values_from = probability,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_pair_posterior_mass = tair10 + `100752`,

    tair10_fraction = if_else(
      gene_pair_posterior_mass > 0,
      tair10 / gene_pair_posterior_mass,
      NA_real_
    ),

    `100752_fraction` = if_else(
      gene_pair_posterior_mass > 0,
      `100752` / gene_pair_posterior_mass,
      NA_real_
    ),

    ambiguity_balance = 2 * pmin(
      tair10_fraction,
      `100752_fraction`
    )
  )

```

```{r}
parental_probabilities %>%
  select(
    sample,
    read_id,
    gene_pair,
    tair10,
    `100752`,
    gene_pair_posterior_mass,
    tair10_fraction,
    `100752_fraction`,
    ambiguity_balance
  ) %>%
  print(n = 10)


```


```{r}
gene_probabilities <- parental_probabilities %>%
  group_by(sample, gene_pair) %>%
  summarise(
    n_molecules = n_distinct(read_id),

    tair10_expected_molecules = sum(tair10, na.rm = TRUE),

    `100752_expected_molecules` = sum(
      `100752`,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    total_pair_posterior_mass = sum(
      gene_pair_posterior_mass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tair10_gene_fraction = if_else(
      total_pair_posterior_mass > 0,
      tair10_expected_molecules /
        total_pair_posterior_mass,
      NA_real_
    ),

    `100752_gene_fraction` = if_else(
      total_pair_posterior_mass > 0,
      `100752_expected_molecules` /
        total_pair_posterior_mass,
      NA_real_
    ),

    gene_ambiguity_balance = 2 * pmin(
      tair10_gene_fraction,
      `100752_gene_fraction`
    )
  )

```

## Quantify 
```{r}
library(data.table)

aln <- fread(
  "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/rsem_quantification/all_alignments_combined.tsv",
  header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
  col.names = c("sample_id", "read_id", "transcript_id", "STAR_NH", "RSEM_ZW"),
  na.strings = "NA"
)[!is.na(RSEM_ZW)]

aln[, `:=`(
  sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
  STAR_NH = as.integer(STAR_NH),
  RSEM_ZW = as.numeric(RSEM_ZW)
)]

genes <- aln[grepl("^AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}\\.[0-9]+_(tair10|100752)$", transcript_id)]
genes[, `:=`(
  gene_id = sub("^(AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}).*$", "\\1", transcript_id),
  genome  = sub("^.*_(tair10|100752)$", "\\1", transcript_id)
)]
```

```{r}
## 2. Collapse isoforms -> read x gene x genome, then to gene_table directly
read_gene <- dcast(
  genes[, .(w = sum(RSEM_ZW)), by = .(sample_id, read_id, gene_id, genome)],
  sample_id + read_id + gene_id ~ genome, value.var = "w", fill = 0
)
setnames(read_gene, c("tair10", "100752"), c("w_tair10", "w_100752"), skip_absent = TRUE)
for (col in c("w_tair10", "w_100752")) if (!col %in% names(read_gene)) read_gene[, (col) := 0]

read_gene[genes[, .(NH = max(STAR_NH)), by = .(sample_id, read_id)],
          NH := i.NH, on = c("sample_id", "read_id")]

gene_table <- read_gene[
  w_tair10 + w_100752 > 0,
  .(
    supporting_reads = .N,
    NH_median = as.numeric(median(NH, na.rm = TRUE)),
    multimapped_frac = mean(NH > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prob_tair10 = sum(w_tair10) /
      (sum(w_tair10) + sum(w_100752))
  ),
  by = .(sample_id, gene_id)
]

gene_table[, prob_100752 := 1 - prob_tair10]
```
